references.text: The same requirement to bring the offering from the small livestock or cattle before the Lord
Parallel text regarding an offering from the small livestock (sheep or goats)
Introduction to the peace offering chapter establishing the requirement for a flawless animal
The same requirement for a flawless female from the small livestock as a sin offering
Detailed requirements that the sacrificial animal must be flawless (תָּמִים) to be accepted
The Passover lamb was to be flawless, a male from the small livestock
Requirement that the sacrificial animal must have no defect
Prophetic vision of a future offering with a flawless lamb
Christ as the flawless Lamb without blemish fulfills the requirement for sacrifice
Christ offered himself flawless (ἄμωμον) to God, fulfilling the requirement for a perfect sacrifice
Confirmation of the requirement for blamelessness for all types of peace offerings, regardless of motive.
Direct continuation in the same chapter specifying the rule for goats within the peace offering.
Highlights the theological purpose behind the requirement for blamelessness: to find favor with the Lord.
